title: RotU: Ritual of the Unknoun (creepypasta)
description: A creepypasta mod focused on unique creature behavior, atmosphere, and player-controlled encounters.
body:
There are many creepypasta mods, but most of them are limited to simple recolored mobs or cheap jumpscares. This mod was created with a different approach.

The main focus is on the behavior of the creatures, inspired by their original stories. Each entity follows its own logic: observing, intervening, or waiting for specific conditions. Some of them do not try to harm the player directly, yet their presence is always felt.
Creatures added by the mod

The mod currently includes 19 different entities inspired by various creepypastas:

-     Amanda
-     Candyman
-     Entity 303
-     Funny
-     Gigant Alex
-     Green Steve
-     Herobrine
-     Lapis Lady
-     Lick
-     Long-Legged
-     Lucas
-     Mimic
-     Molten
-     Object 0
-     That Thing
-     Two-headed
-     Void
-     Vllr
-     White Enderman

Each creature features its own unique behavior and mechanics.

Some entities have expanded behavior compared to their original creepypasta versions. Mimic has more complex behavior compared to its creepypasta counterpart.

The mod does not force encounters. Players decide who and when to summon, learning about each creature and its nature through the in-game book, which contains information about summoning methods, totems, and important notes about each entity.

The mod contains no jumpscares. It is not intended to be a traditional horror mod, but it can still unsettle the player through atmosphere, unexpected behavior, and the feeling that something is constantly watching.

*The mod has been translated into Russian
*Suggestions for adding new creatures are welcome.

 
Distribution Notice

This mod may only be distributed on CurseForge and Modrinth.

Reuploading this mod to other websites without the author's permission is not allowed. Please link to the official mod page instead.
